  public ActionResult processAction(final Action action)
  {
    if (action == null)
    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          return new Failed("Unpushable");
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          return new Failed("Blocked");
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        return new Failed("No undo quota");
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {
        state.undo();
        if (state.getUndoQuota() > 0)
        {
          state.setUndoQuota(state.getUndoQuota() - 1);
        }
        return new Success();
      }
      else
      {
        return new Failed("Nothing to undo");
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      return new Success();
    }
    else
    {
      return new Failed("Unsupported action type");
    }
  }

    }

    if (entityAtTo instanceof Wall || entityAtTo instanceof Player || (entityAtTo instanceof Box && !((Box) entityAtTo).isPushable())) {

    // 3. If entity at 'to' is Empty, move Player from from to to.

      entities.put(from, new Empty());
      entities.put(to, player);

        entities.put(beyond, entityAtTo);
        entities.put(to, player);
        checkpoint();
      }
    }

    currentTransition.record(from, to);

   * Summary: Draws the complete game board state to the configured output stream.

   * Related Features: outputStream, state.entities, state.boardHeight, state.boardWidth, state.destinations, character mapping logic
   * Related Classes: GameState, Position, Entity, Player, Box, Wall, Empty
   * Input: state : GameState - The current game state containing board dimensions, entity placements, and destination coordinates.

   * @generated NOT

  public void render(final GameState state)
  {
      int height = state.getBoardHeight();
      int width = state.getBoardWidth();
      
      // Initialize board with empty spaces (floor)
      char[][] grid = new char[height][width];
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              grid[r][c] = ' ';
          }
      }
      
      // Render destinations
      for (Position dest : state.getDestinations()) {
          if (dest != null && dest.getX() >= 0 && dest.getX() < width && dest.getY() >= 0 && dest.getY() < height) {
              grid[dest.getY()][dest.getX()] = '.';
          }
      }
      
      // Render entities (overwrites destinations if present, adhering to standard layering)
      for (Entity entity : state.getEntities()) {
          if (entity != null && entity.getPosition() != null) {
              Position pos = entity.getPosition();
              int x = pos.getX();
              int y = pos.getY();
              
              if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
                  if (entity instanceof Player) {
                      grid[y][x] = '@';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Box) {
                      grid[y][x] = '$';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Wall) {
                      grid[y][x] = '#';
                  }
                  // Empty entities represent floor, which is already initialized to ' '
              }
          }
      }
      
      // Write grid to output stream with correct alignment and line breaks
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              outputStream.print(grid[r][c]);
          }
          outputStream.println();
      }
      outputStream.flush();
  }

  @Override
  public Object eGet(int featureID, boolean resolve, boolean coreType)
  { ... /* omitted */ }

  public void eSet(int featureID, Object newValue)
  { ... /* omitted */ }

  { ... /* omitted */ }

  { ... /* omitted */ }

   *    d. If entity is Box:

      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());

   *    d. If entity is Box:
   *       i. Verify Box.playerId matches action.initiator. If mismatch, return Failed("Unpushable").

   *    c. Return Success(). Otherwise, return Failed("Nothing to undo").

  {
    if (action == null)
    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          return new Failed("Unpushable");
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          return new Failed("Blocked");
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        return new Failed("No undo quota");
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {
        state.undo();
        if (state.getUndoQuota() > 0)
        {
          state.setUndoQuota(state.getUndoQuota() - 1);
        }
        return new Success();
      }
      else
      {
        return new Failed("Nothing to undo");
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      return new Success();
    }
    else
    {
      return new Failed("Unsupported action type");
    }
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Draws the complete game board state to the configured output stream.
   * Algorithm: 
   * Related Features: outputStream, state.entities, state.boardHeight, state.boardWidth, state.destinations, character mapping logic
   * Related Classes: GameState, Position, Entity, Player, Box, Wall, Empty
   * Input: state : GameState - The current game state containing board dimensions, entity placements, and destination coordinates.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: state is fully initialized; outputStream is open and valid; board dimensions are non-negative integers.
   * Post-condition: The entire game grid, accurately reflecting current entity positions, player/box locations, and destination markers, is written to the outputStream with correct row/column alignment and line breaks.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void render(final GameState state)
  {
      int height = state.getBoardHeight();
      int width = state.getBoardWidth();
      
      // Initialize board with empty spaces (floor)
      char[][] grid = new char[height][width];
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              grid[r][c] = ' ';
          }
      }
      
      // Render destinations
      for (Position dest : state.getDestinations()) {
          if (dest != null && dest.getX() >= 0 && dest.getX() < width && dest.getY() >= 0 && dest.getY() < height) {
              grid[dest.getY()][dest.getX()] = '.';
          }
      }
      
      // Render entities (overwrites destinations if present, adhering to standard layering)
      for (Entity entity : state.getEntities()) {
          if (entity != null && entity.getPosition() != null) {
              Position pos = entity.getPosition();
              int x = pos.getX();
              int y = pos.getY();
              
              if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
                  if (entity instanceof Player) {
                      grid[y][x] = '@';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Box) {
                      grid[y][x] = '$';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Wall) {
                      grid[y][x] = '#';
                  }
                  // Empty entities represent floor, which is already initialized to ' '
              }
          }
      }
      
      // Write grid to output stream with correct alignment and line breaks
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              outputStream.print(grid[r][c]);
          }
          outputStream.println();
      }
      outputStream.flush();
  }

public class TerminalRenderingEngine extends MinimalEObjectImpl.Container implements RenderingEngine
{
  protected static final PrintStream OUTPUT_STREAM_EDEFAULT = null;

  protected PrintStream outputStream = OUTPUT_STREAM_EDEFAULT;

  public void message(final String content)
  { ... /* omitted */ }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Draws the complete game board state to the configured output stream.
   * Algorithm: 
   * Related Features: outputStream, state.entities, state.boardHeight, state.boardWidth, state.destinations, character mapping logic
   * Related Classes: GameState, Position, Entity, Player, Box, Wall, Empty
   * Input: state : GameState - The current game state containing board dimensions, entity placements, and destination coordinates.
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: state is fully initialized; outputStream is open and valid; board dimensions are non-negative integers.
   * Post-condition: The entire game grid, accurately reflecting current entity positions, player/box locations, and destination markers, is written to the outputStream with correct row/column alignment and line breaks.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void render(final GameState state)
  {
      int height = state.getBoardHeight();
      int width = state.getBoardWidth();
      
      // Initialize board with empty spaces (floor)
      char[][] grid = new char[height][width];
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              grid[r][c] = ' ';
          }
      }
      
      // Render destinations
      for (Position dest : state.getDestinations()) {
          if (dest != null && dest.getX() >= 0 && dest.getX() < width && dest.getY() >= 0 && dest.getY() < height) {
              grid[dest.getY()][dest.getX()] = '.';
          }
      }
      
      // Render entities (overwrites destinations if present, adhering to standard layering)
      for (Entity entity : state.getEntities()) {
          if (entity != null && entity.getPosition() != null) {
              Position pos = entity.getPosition();
              int x = pos.getX();
              int y = pos.getY();
              
              if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
                  if (entity instanceof Player) {
                      grid[y][x] = '@';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Box) {
                      grid[y][x] = '$';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Wall) {
                      grid[y][x] = '#';
                  }
                  // Empty entities represent floor, which is already initialized to ' '
              }
          }
      }
      
      // Write grid to output stream with correct alignment and line breaks
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              outputStream.print(grid[r][c]);
          }
          outputStream.println();
      }
      outputStream.flush();
  }

  { ... /* omitted */ }

  { ... /* omitted */ }

  { ... /* omitted */ }

      char[][] grid = new char[height][width];
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              grid[r][c] = ' ';
          }
      }

      for (Position dest : state.getDestinations()) {
          if (dest != null && dest.getX() >= 0 && dest.getX() < width && dest.getY() >= 0 && dest.getY() < height) {

          }

      for (Map.Entry<Position, Entity> entry : state.getEntities().entrySet()) {
          Position pos = entry.getKey();
          Entity entity = entry.getValue();
          
          if (pos != null && entity != null) {
              int x = pos.getX();
              int y = pos.getY();
              
              if (x >= 0 && x < width && y >= 0 && y < height) {
                  if (entity instanceof Player) {
                      grid[y][x] = '@';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Box) {
                      grid[y][x] = '$';
                  } else if (entity instanceof Wall) {
                      grid[y][x] = '#';
                  }
                  // Empty entities represent floor, which is already initialized to ' '
              }
          }
      }
      
      // Write grid to output stream with correct alignment and line breaks
      for (int r = 0; r < height; r++) {
          for (int c = 0; c < width; c++) {
              outputStream.print(grid[r][c]);
          }
          outputStream.println();
      }
      outputStream.flush();

   *    b. Retrieve entity at nextPosition.
   *    c. If entity is Wall or another Player, return Failed("Blocked").
   *    d. If entity is Box:
   *       i. Verify Box.playerId matches action.initiator. If mismatch, return Failed("Unpushable").
   *       ii. Check cell behind box; if not Empty, return Failed("Blocked").
   *       iii. Call state.checkpoint().
   *    e. Execute state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition).
   *    f. Return Success().
   * 3. If action is Undo:

   *    b. If history contains a checkpoint, call state.undo(). If state.undoQuota > 0, decrement state.undoQuota.
   *    c. Return Success(). Otherwise, return Failed("Nothing to undo").

  public ActionResult processAction(final Action action)
  {
    if (action == null)
    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          return new Failed("Unpushable");
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          return new Failed("Blocked");
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        return new Failed("No undo quota");
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {
        state.undo();
        if (state.getUndoQuota() > 0)
        {
          state.setUndoQuota(state.getUndoQuota() - 1);
        }
        return new Success();
      }
      else
      {
        return new Failed("Nothing to undo");
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      return new Success();
    }
    else
    {
      return new Failed("Unsupported action type");
    }
  }

      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);

      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);

        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();

        return new Success();
      }
      else

        return new Failed("Nothing to undo");
      }
    }

      return new Success();
    }
    else

   *    b. Retrieve entity at nextPosition.
   *    c. If entity is Wall or another Player, return Failed("Blocked").
   *    d. If entity is Box:
   *       i. Verify Box.playerId matches action.initiator. If mismatch, return Failed("Unpushable").
   *       ii. Check cell behind box; if not Empty, return Failed("Blocked").
   *       iii. Call state.checkpoint().
   *    e. Execute state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition).
   *    f. Return Success().
   * 3. If action is Undo:

   *    b. If history contains a checkpoint, call state.undo(). If state.undoQuota > 0, decrement state.undoQuota.
   *    c. Return Success(). Otherwise, return Failed("Nothing to undo").

   * @generated NOT

  public ActionResult processAction(final Action action)
  {
    if (action == null)
    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          return new Failed("Unpushable");
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          return new Failed("Blocked");
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        return new Failed("No undo quota");
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {
        state.undo();
        if (state.getUndoQuota() > 0)
        {
          state.setUndoQuota(state.getUndoQuota() - 1);
        }
        return new Success();
      }
      else
      {
        return new Failed("Nothing to undo");
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      return new Success();
    }
    else
    {
      return new Failed("Unsupported action type");
    }
  }

   * 2. If action is Move:
   *    a. Compute nextPosition using action's direction and player's current position.
   *    b. Retrieve entity at nextPosition.
   *    c. If entity is Wall or another Player, return Failed("Blocked").
   *    d. If entity is Box:
   *       i. Verify Box.playerId matches action.initiator. If mismatch, return Failed("Unpushable").

   *    c. Return Success(). Otherwise, return Failed("Nothing to undo").
   * 4. If action is Exit:
   *    a. Set isExitSpecified = true.
   *    b. Return Success().
   * 5. Else, return Failed("Unsupported action type").

   * Input: action : Action - The command to execute, containing initiator ID (int) and directional/type information. No null values allowed.
   * Output: ActionResult - Instance of Success if executed successfully, or Failed with a descriptive reason string otherwise.

   * Post-condition: Game entities are updated per action rules. isExitSpecified is set to true if Exit action. GameState.undoQuota is decremented if applicable. An ActionResult reflecting execution status is returned.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  {
    if (action == null)
    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          return new Failed("Unpushable");
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          return new Failed("Blocked");
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        return new Failed("No undo quota");
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {

      }

      return new Success();

    else
    {
      return new Failed("Unsupported action type");

   * 2. If action is Move:
   *    a. Compute nextPosition using action's direction and player's current position.
   *    b. Retrieve entity at nextPosition.
   *    c. If entity is Wall or another Player, return Failed("Blocked").
   *    d. If entity is Box:
   *       i. Verify Box.playerId matches action.initiator. If mismatch, return Failed("Unpushable").
   *       ii. Check cell behind box; if not Empty, return Failed("Blocked").

   *    b. If history contains a checkpoint, call state.undo(). If state.undoQuota > 0, decrement state.undoQuota.
   *    c. Return Success(). Otherwise, return Failed("Nothing to undo").
   * 4. If action is Exit:
   *    a. Set isExitSpecified = true.
   *    b. Return Success().
   * 5. Else, return Failed("Unsupported action type").

    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      int initiator = action.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPlayerPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(action.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntityAt(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        return new Failed("Blocked");
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          return new Failed("Unpushable");
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntityAt(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          return new Failed("Blocked");
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        return new Failed("No undo quota");
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {
        state.undo();
        if (state.getUndoQuota() > 0)
        {
          state.setUndoQuota(state.getUndoQuota() - 1);
        }
        return new Success();
      }
      else
      {
        return new Failed("Nothing to undo");
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      return new Success();
    }
    else
    {
      return new Failed("Unsupported action type");
    }

   *    c. If entity is Wall or another Player, return Failed("Blocked").
   *    d. If entity is Box:
   *       i. Verify Box.playerId matches action.initiator. If mismatch, return Failed("Unpushable").
   *       ii. Check cell behind box; if not Empty, return Failed("Blocked").
   *       iii. Call state.checkpoint().
   *    e. Execute state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition).
   *    f. Return Success().
   * 3. If action is Undo:
   *    a. If state.undoQuota == 0, return Failed("No undo quota").
   *    b. If history contains a checkpoint, call state.undo(). If state.undoQuota > 0, decrement state.undoQuota.
   *    c. Return Success(). Otherwise, return Failed("Nothing to undo").
   * 4. If action is Exit:
   *    a. Set isExitSpecified = true.
   *    b. Return Success().
   * 5. Else, return Failed("Unsupported action type").
   * Related Features: state, isExitSpecified, GameState.move(), GameState.undo(), GameState.checkpoint(), GameState.undoQuota, history stack, ActionResult instantiation.
   * Related Classes: GameState, Action, ActionResult, Success, Failed, Move, Undo, Exit, Position, Entity, Box, Player, Wall, Empty
   * Input: action : Action - The command to execute, containing initiator ID (int) and directional/type information. No null values allowed.
   * Output: ActionResult - Instance of Success if executed successfully, or Failed with a descriptive reason string otherwise.
   * Pre-condition: state is fully initialized and represents a valid game board. action is not null.
   * Post-condition: Game entities are updated per action rules. isExitSpecified is set to true if Exit action. GameState.undoQuota is decremented if applicable. An ActionResult reflecting execution status is returned.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public ActionResult processAction(final Action action)
  {
    if (action == null)
    {
      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Action cannot be null.");
    }

    if (action instanceof Move)
    {
      Move move = (Move) action;
      int initiator = move.getInitiator();
      Position currentPosition = state.getPosition(initiator);
      Position nextPosition = currentPosition.add(move.getDirection());
      Entity entity = state.getEntity(nextPosition);

      if (entity instanceof Wall || (entity instanceof Player && ((Player) entity).getId() != initiator))
      {
        Failed failed = new Failed();
        failed.setReason("Blocked");
        return failed;
      }

      if (entity instanceof Box)
      {
        Box box = (Box) entity;
        if (box.getPlayerId() != initiator)
        {
          Failed failed = new Failed();
          failed.setReason("Unpushable");
          return failed;
        }
        Position behindBoxPosition = nextPosition.add(box.getDirection());
        Entity behindEntity = state.getEntity(behindBoxPosition);
        if (!(behindEntity instanceof Empty))
        {
          Failed failed = new Failed();
          failed.setReason("Blocked");
          return failed;
        }
        state.checkpoint();
      }

      state.move(currentPosition, nextPosition);
      return new Success();
    }
    else if (action instanceof Undo)
    {
      if (state.getUndoQuota() == 0)
      {
        Failed failed = new Failed();
        failed.setReason("No undo quota");
        return failed;
      }
      if (!state.getHistory().isEmpty())
      {
        state.undo();
        if (state.getUndoQuota() > 0)
        {
          state.setUndoQuota(state.getUndoQuota() - 1);
        }
        return new Success();
      }
      else
      {
        Failed failed = new Failed();
        failed.setReason("Nothing to undo");
        return failed;
      }
    }
    else if (action instanceof Exit)
    {
      setIsExitSpecified(true);
      return new Success();
    }
    else
    {
      Failed failed = new Failed();
      failed.setReason("Unsupported action type");
      return failed;
    }
  }
